# `source.add`

Register a source. No source ships enabled — this call is the explicit opt-in.

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `reversible`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice source-add`
- **MCP tool:** `source_add` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject_id` | `str` | required |  |
| `adapter_type` | `str` | required — one of ['slack_export', 'drive_export', 'gmail_export'] |  |
| `canonical_root` | `str` | required |  |
| `approved_purpose` | `str` | optional, default='voice_generation' |  |

## Examples

```
operator-voice source-add --subject-id subj_abc123 --adapter-type slack_export --canonical-root ./my-notes
```
